create_params.title: Research parameters
create_params.hint: Tune depth, source weights, and report language. Defaults are fine to start; values are submitted with create and visible in the session.
create_params.depth_hint: Depth sets the product-round budget: deeper means more rounds and coverage, at higher cost.

standard.label: Standard
standard.hint: Default — about 5 rounds for most questions.

create_params.weights_hint: 0–1 scale; higher means prefer that source class. Defaults favor official and authoritative secondary sources.

community.label: Community / sentiment
community.hint: Forums, social, and reviews — use as supplement.

create_params.language_hint: Preferred language for delivery and the written report.

errors.empty_goal: Enter a research goal, or pick a template first.
errors.depth_invalid: Choose a valid depth (shallow / standard / deep).
errors.weight_invalid: Enter a valid number between 0 and 1.

create_estimate.title: Cost & duration
create_estimate.disclaimer: Estimate only — not a commitment. Actual time may vary with topic size and clarifications. You can still create when unknown.

connectivity.offline_hint: Research stays on screen — edits are paused until the network returns. No offline editing.
connectivity.reconnect_failed_hint: Check the network, then retry. Your last loaded research is still on screen.
connectivity.server_error_hint: The research service returned an error (5xx). You can retry without losing this session shell.
connectivity.waiting_network_hint: Reconnect to load research. The page will not go blank.
